title: Mission Control Runtime Event V1
description: One runtime event as the Owner-scoped Local API projects it. This is the audit envelope (eidolon.audit.v1) projected for a client: the shared vocabularies are $ref'd from that schema rather than restated, so they cannot drift. Subject references the envelope carries as subject_type/subject_id are expanded into named fields here, because a client should not have to know the taxonomy to find out which companion an event was about.

ingest_seq.description: The audit index's total order on this Host. This is the stream cursor; a client submits the last one it consumed.

producer_seq.description: Monotonic per producer, so a client can detect a gap in one producer without having to trust that the total order has none.

origin.description: No 'mock'. Staged data exists only inside a client.

milestone.description: The semantic phase this event reports, when it carries one. Beats source when a consumer decides which leg of a companion's circuit lit up.

summary.description: Human-readable, composed by the producer. A client must not assemble this from ids: it has neither the taxonomy nor the language.
